New comic featuring the "true" ending to the Dragon Ball Z Abridged story! This is a bit out of ordinary for me, being a more wholesome piece and more focused on sex than expansion, that being said though, there's plenty of hyper, cumflation and hardcore sex in there, as well as my first attempt on a highly requested kink: All The Way Through (ATWT) - I hope you like it! >~<

For context to anyone who hasn't seen it, this is based on the DBZA ending found in Episode 60 part 3! Go check it out if you haven't!
